turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Assalamu Alaikum, Mrs. Khan! This is Sameer calling from Delhi.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wa Alaikum Assalam, Sameer beta. How are you? It has been so long.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am doing well. I was just thinking about you and wondering how your knee pain is these days.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: It is better now, but I still struggle with the stairs. Why are you calling so suddenly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No reason, just calling to chat. By the way, are you planning to come to Lucknow for the Diwali holidays?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am thinking about it, but the tickets are getting very expensive now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Don't worry about that. I have already checked the train fare for your dates.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, really? How much is it showing?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is exactly nine thousand five hundred rupees for the AC tier. I can book it for you if you like.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That is a bit high, isn't it? Let me check with my daughter first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Take your time. Just let me know by tomorrow so I can grab the seat.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I will call you back in the evening. Give my love to everyone there.
